description: This source file defines the aclviewer module, which manages the user interface interactions for Access Control List (ACL) roles in the application. It provides functions for viewing, saving, toggling, showing, and hiding role-related UI components, using AJAX requests to communicate with server-side scripts.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Initiates an AJAX request to load and display ACL role details for a specific role ID and module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Sends form data via AJAX to save ACL role modifications.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles the server response after saving, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the retrieved ACL role data in the UI.

methods.name: toggleDisplay
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of UI components identified by provided ID.
